identity.name: Pilot's Watch Mark XX
identity.one_liner: The 2022 Mark XX — the modern Mark 11 reissue, 40mm, anti-magnetic, 100m water resistance. The IWC pilot watch that replaced the 2016 Mark XVIII.

narrative.story: The Mark XX (2022) replaced the 2016 Mark XVIII, returning to a 40mm case (the Mark XVIII was 39mm and the Mark XVII was 41mm). The 32111 caliber is a Sellita-based automatic with a 5-day reserve. The dial is the classic IWC pilot design — large Arabic numerals, a triangle at 12, and a soft-iron inner case for anti-magnetic resistance up to 80,000 A/m. The Mark XX is the most-cited modern IWC pilot watch and the watch a collector cites when they want an IWC pilot at the under-$5,000 price point.
narrative.collector_notes: The Mark XX has a 100m water resistance, the most of any Mark-series pilot watch. The IWC pilot lineage runs back to the 1948 Mark 11, designed for the British Royal Air Force.
